label: Optics
definition: Decisions that change viewpoint, perspective, focus, or camera feel.
inclusion: Camera, angle, depth, and focus directions.
exclusion: Composition hierarchy and light belong under Stage.

label: Camera
definition: Camera cues and subject-distance choices.
inclusion: Focal cue, distance, depth, and focus axes.
exclusion: A whole preset or mood word is not a camera atom.

label: Angle
definition: Camera elevation, azimuth, and horizon roll.
inclusion: Eye, low, high, top-down, profile, three-quarter, and tilt directions.
exclusion: Foreground layering belongs to composition.

label: Stage
definition: Decisions about arrangement and illumination of the scene.
inclusion: Composition and lighting directions.
exclusion: Camera and finish choices have their own roots.

label: Composition
definition: How subjects, objects, and space are arranged in the frame.
inclusion: Hierarchy, placement, crop, and depth staging.
exclusion: Lighting and campaign finish are separate axes.

label: Lighting
definition: Direction, softness, contrast, time, and practical sources of illumination.
inclusion: Key, contrast, time, fill, and accent choices.
exclusion: Palette and retouch finish belong under Finish.

label: Finish
definition: Surface treatment, palette, and emotional temperature.
inclusion: Look and mood fields.
exclusion: Physical illumination remains under Stage.

label: Look
definition: Genre or treatment visible in the final image.
inclusion: Commercial, editorial, studio, texture, palette, and retouch directions.
exclusion: Look labels do not replace specific camera or light choices.

label: Mood
definition: Emotional temperature or atmosphere.
inclusion: Tone choices that change the read.
exclusion: Premium alone is not an atom without visible cues.

label: Constraints
definition: User-authored keep and avoid directions.
inclusion: IMPORTANT and AVOID records.
exclusion: A named edit operation belongs in Edits.

label: Output
definition: Delivery and format requests.
inclusion: Aspect ratio and resolution cues.
exclusion: Output cues do not prove visual style or exact backend dimensions.

label: Constructed composite
definition: The scene visibly depends on compositing, surreal construction, or impossible spatial relationships.
inclusion: Impossible joins and constructed spatial relationships.
exclusion: Ordinary retouching alone; this family wins when construction defines the preset.

label: Observational
definition: Documentary, candid, or unposed observation defines the visual approach.
inclusion: Unstaged observation and documentary immediacy.
exclusion: Posed work that only looks casual belongs in a directed family.

label: Directed location
definition: Deliberate direction in a recognizable real environment is central.
inclusion: Environmental portraits, lifestyle, street, and location campaigns.
exclusion: Controlled seamless or built-set scenes belong in Directed studio.

label: Directed studio
definition: Controlled studio or built-set capture defines the image.
inclusion: Seamless, softbox, gradient, product, beauty, and constructed studio sets.
exclusion: Not a default for unknown provenance.

label: Commercial
definition: Polished commercial recipe using a controlled, readable hero setup.
inclusion: The proposed commercial seed preset.
exclusion: Location-led variants and palette-specific variants remain separate when their atomic differences matter.

label: Local correction
definition: Change one named detail while preserving the surrounding image.
inclusion: Surgical correction and fix operations.
exclusion: Whole-object removal belongs to object removal.

label: Object removal
definition: Remove a named object, person, or text and rebuild the affected background.
inclusion: Single-target removal operations.
exclusion: Broad environmental simplification needs a separate recipe.

label: Reference style transfer
definition: Transfer only named visual treatment from a reference.
inclusion: Tone and style-only recipes with explicit role limits.
exclusion: Face, pose, product, and scene swaps are separate.

label: Quality restoration
definition: Restore fidelity without redesign, restyle, or recompose.
inclusion: HQ and anti-degradation operations.
exclusion: New visual direction or reframe.

label: Reference composite
definition: Combine role-limited references into a base scene.
inclusion: Multi-reference, face, pose, and product transfer.
exclusion: Style-only reference transfer has no identity or object transfer.

label: Geometry
definition: Correct perspective or marked geometry.
inclusion: Vanishing-point correction, camera lock, and markup-led placement.
exclusion: A crop change belongs to reframe.
